strict_prepare.interpretation: The original guard functions are replayed over their saved snapshots. Activity/window snapshots and launch are separate Android operations; the host lock does not serialize concurrent user or system activity.

timing.background_interval_clock: Android elapsedRealtime; excludes earlier admission and later release work.

final_configuration_setup_separate_from_.recommendation_scope: Previously verified ordinary Notes tool tasks; not a claim that all Apps or complex flight goals pass.

generic_tools.execution: The native-app route has a general observe/model/validate/action loop over observed targets, allowed packages and task authorization.
limits: A general action layer does not supply a general business-goal verifier.
The web-helper route requires a recognized supported web goal.
Recognized native flight and shopping domains forbid booking, purchase and payment.
Provider/page support and current accessibility or visual evidence remain necessary.
generic_tools.successful_completion: TaskCompletionGate has goal-specific independent verifiers. Unsupported goals remain unverified_goal; the grammar excludes success when no verifier is available.

supported_scope.scope: Several natural-language prefixes and literal body forms; save-and-reopen proof is required. Natural-form body limit is 94 UTF-16 code units.
Supported provider pages with explicit date and city parameters for one-way, one-adult read-only searches.
Recognized AX3000T price queries on supported Xiaomi app or official website pages.

analysis.recommendation_scope: Choose the default using same-APK ordinary tasks and verified cleanup/background behavior. Model-card scores or tokens per second alone do not justify replacement.

visual_models.conclusion: An existing ordinary visual-tools candidate with real historical Notes successes. Current-APK flight, shopping, purchase and arbitrary-GUI completion are not established.
visual_models.current_integration: Ordinary VlmInferenceAdapter with observe or tools mode; exact NPU, 8192-context and 4-thread configuration with pinned image, projector and worker checks.

historical_cases.scope: Notes result reviewed; other historical foreground-coexistence operations are not independently scored here.

generation_stop.correction: Read cancellation-specific app fields and nested native cleanup; preserve exact request, generation, installed worker path, PID/starttime, original bytes and SDK cancellation bindings.
generation_stop.latency_clock: Both controller timestamps are Android elapsedRealtime. No subtraction from native CLOCK_MONOTONIC.
limits: The token callback is not proof of an NPU kernel executing at the exact tap instant.
Pre-tap observation and result publication are not atomic; phase-6 cancellation and incomplete generation were checked afterward.
This cancellation case does not claim Notes business completion.

orvena_gpu.interpretation: The request missed its generation deadline. The controller exhausted its 72 s wait before the 73,017 ms callback and retained the interrupted task as blocked. Later process exit does not retroactively qualify the task or prove SDK cleanup.
limits: One generated token is not a steady-state decode benchmark.
The old harness did not send normal Stop after status became blocked; this is not a generation-stop success test.
Ordinary recovery established a new idle session without changing the historical failure.

interpretation_limits: The model/backend comparison contains single successful task samples and a repeated LFM3 sample. It is not a statistically powered benchmark or general app-coverage test.
Cross-model samples were collected on the earlier build. The new combined-build Notes regressions use LFM3; this is not a controlled same-build comparison of all models.
Successful notes cases demonstrate one local-model tool selection followed by a bounded controller save/list/reopen workflow.
Business route flags, model success claims, observed goal verification, process cleanup and SDK cleanup binding are distinct.
Runtime receipts and allocation logs identify the selected backend; they do not independently measure per-operator utilization or TOPS.
Moto Notes uses actual native app tools. Price and official flight cases use the dedicated web helper and do not qualify native Xiaomi/Ctrip purchases or bookings.

All four historical shopping cases through build 81c5 retain their original explicit single-unit/specifications/price-condition contract. They are not natural-price-only tests, and a later natural-price result cannot qualify these failed legacy requests.
No shopping purchase, payment, flight result, thermal endurance or restart-persistence result is inferred from notes.
Main-display input count zero and sampled focus unchanged do not measure concurrent foreground touch responsiveness or frame rate.
Host collection wall time is excluded from task timing. Background-to-terminal is narrower than the complete task lifecycle.

The product target-display broker is spawned on the phone by the controller using already-authorized su; it requires available root authorization, accessibility service and an unlocked device. The outer UI display helper is a separate host/ADB test fixture. Disconnected-host and reboot qualification has not been performed in these cases.

not_started_attempts.interpretation: The driver refused Start because insufficient helper lifetime remained. This is a preflight guard outcome, not a model or tool-task failure.
